Our Vision

To build intelligent solutions that empower safe, scientific, and sustainable exploration of Mars and beyond. Ares Forge envisions a future where data, AI, and human ingenuity together unlock the mysteries of other worlds.

Our Way of Working

Ares Forge is a multidisciplinary team of dreamers, builders, and problem-solvers — combining expertise in AI, data science, software engineering, and space exploration. We're work collaboratively turning NASA real data into impactful tools.
